subject: Deployment economics: commit matrix & pilot cost sensitivity
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + sizing ask (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Alex — thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can model costs accurately: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary workload: interactive Q&A and batch nightly embeddings for search re-index (peak interactive: ~400 reqs/min, average 180 reqs/min).
- Typical prompt size: 400 tokens in, ~350 tokens out average.
- Compliance requirement: data isolation for search index metadata (PII redaction in pipeline).
- Desired pilot: 2 weeks of production-shaped traffic (incl. a weekend burst).

What we need from you to finalize the cost model: 
1) Expected steady-state daily token volume (approx): tokens in + out per day.
2) Peak sustained concurrency for 30s windows (helps sizing for Dedicated pools).
3) Any strict SLA/uptime targets above standard (e.g., 99.95%).

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm the three items above by EOD Fri.
- We’ll send a side-by-side cost sheet comparing Hosted per-token, Dedicated reserved commit options (monthly commit and burst), and Private VPC one-time infra estimate + recurring platform fee.
- Offer: two-week pilot with a capped reserved burst for the first week (to simulate growth).

Attachments: none in this message.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Alex Chen <alex@clearpath.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + sizing ask (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline: 
1) Token volume: approximate daily tokens = 1.2M tokens in + 1.05M tokens out = ~2.25M tokens/day (weekdays). Nightly batch embeddings add ~400k embedding tokens (short calls).
2) Peak concurrency: we see short peaks ~600 reqs/min during business hours; sustained 30s concurrency is ~12–14 active requests.
3) SLA: 99.9% is fine for now. If we go enterprise, we may require 99.95 but not necessary for the pilot.

Pilot: 2 weeks starting if we can get a simple SOW and a pilot cost cap (we'd like a clear $ ceiling for the pilot).

A few questions to help model: 
- For Dedicated reserved commit: what is the typical commit term (monthly or annual) and can we do a 30-day rolling?
- For Private: ballpark of one-time setup + minimum recurring platform fee? We have procurement constraints and that helps the finance team.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful — Tue morning PST works.

— Alex Chen
Head of Product | ClearPath Analytics
alex@clearpath.ai | 617-555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + sizing ask (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — ballpark math

Alex — quick ballpark so you have numbers to take to procurement. I’ll do three short scenarios using your weekday volume (2.25M tokens/day) and peak data you sent. Assumptions: 22 business days/month.

1) Hosted (per-token):
- Price example: $0.0006 per prompt token / $0.0007 per completion token (illustrative).
- Monthly tokens: 2.25M * 22 = 49.5M tokens/month. Split in/out ratio: ~54% in / 46% out -> cost ~ (26.7M * 0.0006) + (22.8M * 0.0007) = $16.02k + $15.96k = ~$32k/month.
- Pros: zero infra, elastic with bursts. Cons: cost scales linearly, less control for isolation without Private.

2) Dedicated (reserved commit):
- Typical commit SKU: hourly-equivalent GPU pool; example commit level that fits your steady throughput = 1x T4-equivalent pool (example only).
- Example pricing: $18k/month base commit (includes baseline throughput and 8h peak headroom), burst overage at reduced per-token or per-GPU-hour rate.
- For your usage, Dedicated likely brings unit cost down ~20–35% vs hosted depending on sustained utilization and batching (so $12–25k/month range).
- Term flexibility: we can do 1-month rolling for pilots; annual/quarterly gives better unit price.

3) Private (VPC/on-prem):
- One-time onboarding + infra sizing: $90k–150k for small private footprint (hardware, network, security integration) + a recurring platform fee (example $6k–12k/mo).
- Operational breakpoint: best if you have sustained high throughput or hard isolation/compliance needs.

Pilot offer (two-week):
- We can do a capped pilot for $6,500 (includes dedicated burst reserve equivalent + cost monitoring and two engineering hours/day support weekdays).
- If you prefer a hosted pilot, we can price at per-token with a $4,000 cap.

I’ll attach a short spreadsheet with the math and assumptions.

— Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Alex Chen <alex@clearpath.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-13T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + sizing ask (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — ballpark math

Thanks Marcus — this is really helpful and in the right ranges. Couple clarifying points: 
- Your hosted per-token assumption — are those list prices or can we expect promotional/commit credits for a pilot?
- For Dedicated: can you clarify how burst overage is billed? Per-GPU-hour or a blended per-token for bursts? We want predictable ceilings.
- For Private: do you have a reference SOW for the $90k number (procurement likes line-items).

We’re leaning towards trying a dedicated pilot with a capped burst (to simulate our weekend traffic). If you can do the $6.5k capped pilot with a simple SOW and a 30-day rolling commit for the post-pilot month, we can greenlight next week.

Also — happy to take the 20-min Tue morning call to iron things out before we sign anything.

— Alex

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment economics: commit matrix & pilot cost sensitivity — pilot SOW and attachments

Alex — great to hear you’re leaning into a Dedicated pilot. Attached: pilot-cost-sheet.xlsx (detailed assumptions + sensitivity tabs) and MCP-terms-draft.pdf (pilot SOW + 30-day rolling commitment language). Highlights: 
- Pilot fee: $6,500 flat; includes one week of dedicated burst (up to 2x steady throughput) and one week steady-state dedicated pool, plus standard monitoring and 8 engineering support hours/week.
- Post-pilot: auto-offer for 30-day rolling Dedicated commit at the same per-month baseline; upgrade discounts for quarterly/annual commitments are listed in the attachment.
- Billing: We offer burst overage as "per-GPU-hour" with a capped blended rate option on request (we included both lines in the spreadsheet).

Next steps: 
1) Sign SOW (DocuSign link in the HubSpot deal page) or reply to this thread approving the pilot fee and SOW language.
2) We’ll provision the pilot pool and schedule a kickoff (30–45 minutes) to validate traffic shaping.

If you want any line-item changes for procurement, I can produce a broken-out SOW by EOD.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
